context_preflight_contract.transport: existing authenticated per-host MCC SSH transport; exactly one selected instance per invocation
context_preflight_contract.output: stdout JSON only; exact fields, no database name, connection identity or credentials. Failure has no execution_context; unknown never supplies null/default context.
context_preflight_contract.read_only: read configuration/includes, discovered layout and explicit local PHP values only; do not use migrating/recovering config loader, record history, connect to DB, bootstrap app or run Mautic commands
context_preflight_contract.selection: requested root must already be the canonical absolute application root; reject aliases, symlinks/ambiguous layouts, parent traversal, mismatched UID, absent explicit prefix or local db_name inconsistency. Distinct roots sharing a database are distinct selections.

workflow.enqueue: fresh context preflight -> MCC authenticated selected Host/InstanceCache UID/root verification -> resolve and persist one immutable plan with exact context -> dispatch inline or private file+canonical SHA
workflow.retry_recovery: fresh preflight -> compare selected instance and stored immutable context/hash -> dispatch same plan; do not resolve a new catalog or replace context after mutation
workflow.bulk: separate preflight and immutable plan per selected instance/root; missing per-instance context is fail-closed, never reuse one prefix or plan for instance=all
workflow.rollback: use same persisted immutable plan; explicit retry/rollback preflight must match its context; MCD independently rediscovers and observes fresh rollback barriers before any source restore
workflow.evidence: require and independently validate typed facts_receipt at final upgrade evidence gate as well as authenticated evidence endpoint

resolve_execution_context.authority: MCD independently discovers the selected instance and requires explicit local db_table_prefix and db_name matching discovery; missing/unknown context is omitted, never null or guessed. Empty prefix is allowed only when explicitly proved locally.
resolve_execution_context.producer: authenticated MCC verifies selected instance UID and canonical application root; typed plans require both advertised features and agent >=1.2.65, persist and echo exact request context. Missing or changed context blocks typed apply/rollback. Legacy file-only plans remain compatible.
resolve_execution_context.consumer: MCD rejects typed response context unequal to fresh request context and independently rediscovers it again during read-only observation; database identity is not an MCC-supplied input.

facts_receipt_contract.plan_sha256_input: original immutable selected plan with operation replaced by apply; all other fields unchanged
facts_receipt_contract.invocation_sha256_input: object with receipt equal to receipt minus invocation and invocation_sha256, operation equal to invocation.operation, phase equal to invocation.phase
facts_receipt_contract.ordered_facts: visit patches in plan order, then preconditions before rollback_preconditions, preserving predicate order; deduplicate by canonical predicate SHA-256 at first occurrence. facts array must match this sequence exactly, including predicate objects.

column_integer_domain.matched: true only with null_count=invalid_count=0 and integer schema

migration_execution_state.exact_match_count: 0 for pending, 1 for executed; other values reject
migration_execution_state.storage_sha256_input: sorted complete verified UTF-8 FQCN storage value array

facts_receipt_contract.records: object keyed by exact selected patch IDs; each value has exactly preconditions and rollback_preconditions booleans, recomputed as conjunction over its mapped facts; absent list is empty conjunction true
independent_verification: Require receipt for every typed selected plan; reject extra/missing keys, unknown schemas, wrong JSON types and noncanonical digests.
Bind execution_context to persisted immutable plan context and authenticated selected instance; observation.table_prefix equals context.table_prefix.
Recompute original apply plan digest; compare run_id/source_version/target_version/trigger/plan_phase to immutable plan, not mutable evidence fields.
Reconstruct ordered predicates from immutable plan; require exact fact predicate sequence and recompute matched booleans, records and all_matched.

Verify database_identity digest, observation_binding digest and invocation digest independently; invocation operation/phase must equal submitted evidence operation/phase and be permitted by the immutable plan workflow.

Configured endpoint digest and migration storage digest are host attestations: without independently known endpoint/storage bytes MCC cannot recompute them; do not claim otherwise. Pin database identity and endpoint digest to first accepted admission for this run and reject later drift.
Fresh admission/apply/rollback observation invariants are identical excluding invocation; conditional skips stay explicit. Successful phase is not proof that skipped patches were applied.

column_integer_domain.semantics: verified integer schema and complete domain; sorted unique integer values, never booleans; any NULL, invalid value, missing or nontransactional schema blocks

table_row_count.semantics: each filtered column requires a matching column_integer_domain predicate in the same condition group; exact typed integers, validated identifiers and bound values; unknown never becomes zero

migration_execution_state.semantics: textual UTF-8 storage, byte-exact returned FQCN; zero exact matches pending, one executed, duplicate exact match/NULL/numeric alias/case-folded target near-match/unknown schema or encoding blocks; no storage initialization

typed_predicate_contract.selection: all facts are read in a read-only repeatable-read transaction before any skip; verified precondition conjunction false is skip_condition_not_required, true retains source gates; unknown blocks
typed_predicate_contract.binding: execution_context required for typed records, independently rediscovered selected instance must match UID/application-root/explicit local prefix and DB name; actual server/database identity and configured connection fingerprint are bound to receipts, never credentials
typed_predicate_contract.hashing: sorted compact ensure_ascii UTF-8 JSON plus LF; observations_sha256 binds original apply plan/hash/run/source/target/trigger/plan phase/context/database identity and ordered typed observations; invocation_sha256 additionally binds actual operation and phase; timestamps excluded
typed_predicate_contract.admission: read before target preparation, re-read before live source mutation, before phase apply and immediately before file writes; any observation or context drift blocks
typed_predicate_contract.rollback: all rollback_preconditions for the complete plan must be verified true; original receipts and complete reverse snapshot hash chain checked before any phase restores. Executed or unknown dependent migration blocks; no SQL/down migration

version_policy.upgrade_lifecycle: source_version must be lower than target_version
version_policy.other_triggers: when version is known, source_version and target_version must both equal the observed version; source_version greater than target_version is rejected
version_policy.unknown_version: when observed version is absent, plan source_version and target_version are null; selection is accepted only when the agent independently confirms the Mautic major, active catalog explicitly allows unknown versions for every selected record, and all vulnerable source-signature gates match; otherwise return blocked/noop without mutation
version_policy.authority: MCC selects applicability from the active effective catalog; MCD independently validates the returned version relation and never supplies version-specific fallback

request_operation_semantics: operation is required and must be one of status, verify, apply, rollback; run_id is required for rollback and optional for other operations; target_version is optional for non-upgrade triggers and MCC resolves it to the observed version
payload_path_semantics: git_patch_v1 payload_path is a safe root-independent relative key ending in .patch, with no empty, dot, dotdot, backslash, absolute, or drive-qualified component; it exactly matches one unique payloads[].path. db_json_normalize_v1 has no payload_path or payload object.
payload_integrity: base64 must decode strictly; decoded bytes must match lowercase SHA-256 and configured size limits before plan execution; payload paths are unique
selected_record_order: patches are the exact MCC-selected list in dependency and phase_order order; MCD preserves the list and rejects duplicate IDs/paths or invalid order rather than sorting or selecting records locally
plan_phase_semantics: for daemon_reconcile, plugin_reload_failure, and operator_action plans, every selected record must declare the requested phase; for a complete upgrade_lifecycle plan, top-level phase is dependency_update_preflight and patch records declare their later exact execution phases, so the preflight anchor need not appear in each record
upgrade_execution_semantics: MCC passes one immutable v3 upgrade plan inline to the existing mautic-upgrade command using --patch-plan-json and --patch-run-id; MCD validates it once, performs atomic preflight across all declared upgrade records before source mutation, applies each record only at its declared phases, and reports evidence against the same registry and plan hashes; MCD does not resolve a second catalog snapshot during the upgrade
application_root_binding: all source_paths, diff paths and gate paths are relative to the canonical Mautic application root containing app/, plugins/ and bin/console, for ZIP and Composer. The workflow verifies a unique root at the selected root, docroot/ or public/ and rejects ambiguous/symlink layouts. Composer project/lock root is separate staging metadata. Payloads must be normalized to application-relative paths (plugins/...), never silently stripped or relocated by the executor.
gate_only_source_paths: source_paths is the union of safe declared diff paths and gate-only identity paths; gate-only files are checked but never rewritten or backed up as a mutation. Common identity gates in both groups are accepted; only complete all-group matches determine candidate/already. Identity drift blocks apply and rollback.
plan_file_transport: large binary plans use root-owned private regular host files (0600), bounded by max_plan_bytes: mautic-upgrade --patch-plan-file FILE --patch-plan-sha256 CANONICAL_SHA --patch-run-id RUN; mautic-patch-plan and mautic-patch-backup-authorize use --plan-file FILE --plan-sha256 CANONICAL_SHA. File SHA means canonical plan JSON plus LF, not raw formatting bytes. Reject symlinks, wrong owner/permissions, duplicate keys, oversize or hash mismatch. Inline JSON remains supported for small plans; exactly one transport is allowed. Authenticated MCC job transfers the file; no payload-sized argv is required.
target_staging: before maintenance/permission changes/source installation, prepare exact target in an isolated copy with scripts disabled; verify target version and all selected payload/gate conditions there. Bind plan hash, target version, target package hash (ZIP exact bytes or Composer exact lock bytes) and selected target-file hash map. Recheck original source/version before mutation; use staged Composer lock or same ZIP hash; recheck installed target/version/file hashes before applying any patch. Clean the isolated tree on every terminal path. Unsupported upgrade record phases fail closed before source mutation.
dependency_resolution: MCC returns the effective selected records in validated dependency and phase_order order; MCD does not independently select IDs or infer dependencies
git_patch_parameters: currently parameters must be absent or an empty object; unimplemented DB, dependency, policy and method predicates must never be hidden in ignored parameters. A nonempty object is rejected until a typed capability is published.
registry_identity: registry_commit is the opaque 40-hex ID of the exact effective merged snapshot used for selection; registry_sha256 hashes the exact immutable bytes for that same effective snapshot. catalog_revision/catalog_sha256 separately identify MCC operator Assets provenance. Upstream-only registry provenance must use separately named fields and must not replace effective registry identity.

payload_contract.git_patch_v1: bounded UTF-8 or Git-binary patch bytes in payloads with exact SHA-256; paths must be declared, relative, root-contained, and symlink-safe; deletion and rename are rejected
payload_contract.db_json_normalize_v1: typed declarative parameters only; no SQL, shell, PHP, or executable text; the agent validates identifiers and schema and executes only its fixed implementation

db_json_normalize_v1_parameters.identifier_validation: table and column must match the agent's strict identifier grammar and exist in the selected instance schema; values are parameter-bound
db_json_normalize_v1_parameters.rollback: persist row keys and original values; restore a row only if its current column value still equals the recorded replacement; otherwise fail closed

plugin_reload_retry_semantics: before each plugin reload, run the catalog-selected db_json_normalize_v1 capability at most once when the instance database and declared column exist; if and only if reload fails with the exact plugin_update_metadata_array_null signature, run the same normalization once more and retry reload once; missing database/column means skip, and other errors are never retried
m6_runtime_remediation_semantics: the daemon retains its current planning-cycle cadence; when observed_version is unknown, it may request a catalog-selected remediation only after independently confirming observed_major=6, and only the selected record may permit unknown version; the vulnerable source-signature gates still decide whether apply is safe
legacy_state_import_semantics: when current source matches fixed gates, the agent may recognize a pre-v3 backup only through the selected record's declared legacy_state descriptor; it verifies declared relative paths, metadata marker/path fields when present, backup original SHA, current patched SHA, and vulnerable/fixed gates. Read-only status reports validated legacy rollback availability without writing. Apply or rollback may atomically import the snapshot into the generic ledger. Any mismatch fails closed; no legacy filename, marker, or patch ID is hardcoded in the executor.

legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.suffixes: suffixes are appended to the declared source path basename; they must be simple dot-prefixed filename suffixes with no slash, backslash, or parent traversal
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.backup_file: metadata_suffix and expected_marker are null and metadata_fields is empty; both backup bytes and current bytes must independently satisfy the selected record vulnerable/fixed gates
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.backup_file_with_metadata: metadata_suffix is required; metadata_fields maps semantic names marker, path, original_sha256, applied_sha256 to JSON object keys; expected_marker is a catalog value; source path, marker, original hash, applied hash, and both vulnerable/fixed gates must match
legacy_state_descriptor_semantics.plan_presence: legacy_state is returned on every selected record that declares it, including status and rollback plans; MCD never infers a descriptor from a patch ID or local filename

exact_count.expected_count: nonnegative integer, never boolean; fixed group requires positive count
exact_count.allow_missing_path: boolean; true is allowed only for expected_count=0

sha256.expected_sha256: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of exact regular-file bytes; absent file never matches

gate_field_schemas.common: reject unknown fields; path must be a safe relative source_paths entry; groups vulnerable and fixed must both be nonempty; symlinks and nonregular files are rejected

gate_logic_semantics: all means every gate in that group matches; exactly_one requires exactly one declared gate per group. Vulnerable-only means candidate; fixed-only means already; both or neither means ambiguous and blocks mutation.

backup_attestation.required_scope: schema-repair attestation for guarded source-major 6 to target-major 7; same-major 7 to 7 repair attestation required=false; this never waives baseline MCC operational backup policy, do_backup, or per-phase file snapshots
backup_attestation.authenticity: HMAC-SHA256 using the existing root-owned /etc/mcd/mcc-operation-signing.key; context and key files must be private regular files. Unsigned mutable job fields are never accepted.
backup_attestation.signature_bytes: UTF-8 json.dumps(envelope without signature, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); no trailing newline
backup_attestation.plan_hash_bytes: UTF-8 json.dumps(the original immutable plan, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) plus one LF; plan_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256
backup_attestation.manifest_hash_bytes: exact bytes of backup_path/.mcd-backup.json; sha256 is lowercase SHA-256
backup_attestation.binding: instance_uid/root/source_version/target_version/run_id/plan_sha256 must equal the invocation; backup_id begins instance_uid + ':'; completed marker must contain that instance/root and match ID/hash/time/positive bytes_written
backup_attestation.lifetime: issued_at/expires_at are integer Unix seconds, issued_at <= now < expires_at, lifetime <= 3600 seconds; nonce is lowercase 32-hex; manifest age <= 86400 seconds
backup_attestation.issue_cli: mautic-patch-backup-authorize --root ROOT --instance-uid UID --plan-json PLAN --backup-evidence-json EVIDENCE --output-file FILE --signing-key-file KEY
backup_attestation.consume_cli: mautic-upgrade apply --patch-backup-context-file FILE; key comes from --repair-auth-key-file
backup_attestation.sequence: resolve immutable plan at enqueue; complete backup; host-authorize separate attestation; validate before any source mutation. Attestation is outside the plan and never changes its hash.
backup_attestation.unsupported_predicates: method-scope and dependency-package/version predicates remain unsupported; typed DB facts are separate preconditions/rollback_preconditions, never hidden in source gates or parameters; owner records remain disabled until published consumer acceptance

status_semantics: read-only; evaluate selected-record gates and report already-correct, candidate, ambiguous, or blocked without writing files or database rows
verify_semantics: read-only; validate the immutable selected plan, payload hashes, paths, source gates, and applicable patch preconditions without mutation
apply_semantics: idempotent; atomically apply the selected phase; already-correct state is a no-op; partial, mixed, unknown, stale, unsafe-path, or payload-integrity state fails closed
rollback_semantics: bound to run_id and the persisted immutable plan/hash; restore original bytes, mode, uid, and gid or remove a created file only if its current SHA-256 equals the recorded after SHA-256; database rows restore only when their current value equals the recorded replacement; drift is never overwritten
phase_atomicity: runtime invocation is atomic per phase; upgrade preflight remains atomic across its declared internal phases; lifecycle phases are invoked separately by their owning workflow
facts_receipt_evidence: required whenever the selected plan declares typed preconditions or rollback_preconditions; includes independent instance/database binding, ordered observations and canonical digests. Conditional skips retain their recorded decisions and facts; a successful phase does not imply its skipped patches were applied.
evidence_integrity: MCC verifies the authenticated host owns instance_uid and verifies registry, catalog, and plan hashes before recording evidence
host_identity: MCD sends its configured mcc_host_name and hostname; it never supplies MCC Host.id. MCC resolves host identity server-side, returns the derived host_id in the resolve response, and requires that UUID together with the host names on evidence submission.
cache_semantics: catalog bytes are not an MCD source of truth; a cache hint is only catalog_revision plus catalog_sha256; a stale or unknown hint returns a complete immutable selected plan
